title: Build a Snack Plate
learning_objectives: Practice picking foods that give energy

events.description: Let's build a yummy snack plate! Pick something colorful to start!

choices.label: Apple slices
choices.effect: Crunchy apple slices! Red goes on the plate!

choices.label: Carrot sticks
choices.effect: Orange carrot sticks! So crunchy and bright!

events.description: Great pick! Now let's add something that gives you lots of energy!

choices.label: Cheese cubes
choices.effect: Yummy cheese! It helps you grow strong!

choices.label: Peanut butter dip
choices.effect: Peanut butter is so good for dipping!

events.description: Your plate looks amazing! One more thing to make it perfect!

choices.label: Grapes
choices.effect: Sweet purple grapes! Your plate is so colorful!

choices.label: Crackers
choices.effect: Crunchy crackers! A great addition to your plate!

recap_template: You built a wonderful snack plate with foods that give you energy! Your plate was so colorful and delicious.
positive_framing_rules: Never label foods as healthy or unhealthy
Use 'foods that give you energy' instead of 'healthy foods'
ai_variation_allowed: Describe the colors and textures of the food
Add fun facts about the foods
Have a stuffed animal friend comment on the plate

title: Fruit or Cookie?
learning_objectives: Think about what gives your body energy
Learn that all foods can be part of snack time

events.description: It's snack time at school! Your teacher put two choices on the table. Which one do you pick?

choices.label: Strawberries
choices.effect: Sweet strawberries! They give you energy to play at recess!

choices.label: A cookie
choices.effect: A yummy cookie! What a nice treat!

events.description: After recess, you're thirsty! What would you like to drink?

choices.label: Water
choices.effect: Refreshing water! Your body loves water!

choices.label: Apple juice
choices.effect: Sweet apple juice! Tastes like apples!

events.description: It's almost time to go home. Your friend shares their snack with you! Which one do you try?

choices.label: Banana
choices.effect: Bananas are so sweet and soft! What a nice friend!

choices.label: Goldfish crackers
choices.effect: Crunchy crackers! It's fun to share snacks!

recap_template: You made great snack choices today! You tried different foods and thought about what gives your body energy.
positive_framing_rules: Never say a snack choice was bad or wrong
Frame all foods positively — treats and fruits alike
Use 'gives you energy' not 'healthy vs unhealthy'
ai_variation_allowed: Change the specific fruit or snack options
Add a fun character who serves the snacks
Describe how the food tastes and feels

title: Lunch Box Packer
learning_objectives: Practice picking items within a limit
Build a lunch that gives energy all day

events.description: Time to pack your lunch box! You can pick 3 things. What goes in first?

choices.label: A sandwich
choices.effect: A yummy sandwich! That will keep you full!

choices.label: Pasta in a container
choices.effect: Pasta is so fun to eat! Great pick!

events.description: What else should go in your lunch box?

choices.label: An orange
choices.effect: A juicy orange! So bright and sweet!

events.description: One more thing to finish your lunch box!

choices.label: Celery sticks
choices.effect: Crunchy celery! So fun to munch on!

choices.label: A cheese stick
choices.effect: A cheese stick! Easy to eat and gives you energy!

recap_template: You packed a wonderful lunch box all by yourself! You picked different foods that will give you energy for the whole day.
positive_framing_rules: Never judge any food choice negatively
Celebrate the variety of foods chosen
ai_variation_allowed: Change the specific food options offered
Add descriptions of fun lunch box designs
Have the student imagine opening their lunch at school
